== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Droid Walker (Errata)]] (Virtual Block 6.3 slip 3•21), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text; the other versions of the card are [[Droid Walker]] (original).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), unchanged in every capture to 11 January 2013. The card list writes icons out; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploys -1 to same site as your MTT. AT-AT Cannon may deploy aboard, and targets it hits cannot be used to satisfy attrition. Unless alone, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1006_L6266</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>2_156</code>, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
